featured_reviews.review_text:
Sunteck Realty Naigaon has been a huge disappointment. As seen in the attached images, this is the current condition outside the balconies facing the terrace area above the Flipkart shop in Tower 1. The entire area is extremely unhygienic and has started creating breathing and health issues for residents. Living here genuinely feels like a mistake despite investing so much in this property.

Even after multiple complaints, no proper action has been taken by the builder regarding pending work. Construction soil, cement, and debris have been lying here for more than a year, and the dust enters our homes daily. The drainage system near the garage and terrace area has no proper cover, causing dirty water accumulation, foul smell, and mosquito issues. Many drainage chambers and pipelines are damaged, open, or left without proper maintenance and regular checkups.

Lower-floor residents and shop owners have repeatedly raised complaints regarding leakage issues, stagnant dirty water, broken pipelines, and incomplete work since the time of possession.

We also escalated the matter to the management team, C&W, and Sunteck Realty HO, where we were informed that the previous vendor left the work incomplete. However, even after such a long time, no new vendor has been appointed. Most officials either avoid the issue or make false promises without any resolution.

Please think about your family’s health and living conditions before choosing Sunteck. Stay safe and stay healthy

Subject: Warning to Investors: Systematic Mismanagement and False Promises
​I am writing this as a two-time investor with Sunteck Realty to warn others: Do not be fooled by the marketing. My experience across two different projects has been a series of broken commitments and zero accountability.
​Project 1: Sunteck Maxxworld (Naigaon)
Operational Negligence: My electricity bill has been incorrectly mapped to another flat since possession in April 2025. Despite 10+ months of follow-ups, Sunteck refuses to fix this.
Zero Accountability: Even after escalating to the grievance team and Mr. Sanjay Kumar Kanojia, there has been total radio silence.
​Missing Infrastructure: OC was obtained and maintenance handed over without basic necessities like Municipality water or a Sewage Treatment Plant (STP).
​​Project 2: Sunteck Beach Residences SBR (Vasai)
​Bait and Switch: The sales team promised a high-elevation beach view with 4 podium levels. Now, CRM (Chanda) confirms there is no podium and the view is primarily of the city.
​Lack of Transparency: When asked to put these revised plans in writing via email, the CRM team refused to commit.
​Don't be blinded by their fancy brochures. While investing they had shown the drone views and shared the snippet of the actual view which we would be getting from the flat. And now they are not commiting to the same view.
Dikhao pe na jao, apni akal ladao.
They take your money and stop responding. Save yourself the stress and be cautious before investing!
